title: Quantifying Emotional Specificity and Ambiguity in Emojis: An Entropy Based Analysis of Discrete Emotion Ratings

contributions.purpose: 量化单个emoji对离散情绪的表达特异性/模糊度
contributions.mechanism: 改编emodiversity的Shannon熵思路,基线校正后对13种情绪评分计算归一化熵,定义情绪特异性指数ESI=1-H/log13
contributions.evaluation: ESI范围约0.015–0.233(均值0.12);低值=模糊,高值=集中于单一情绪
contributions.source_quote: we introduce an entropy-based emotion specificity index (ESI) to quantify how concentrated the ratings of an emoji in one emotion.

contributions.purpose: 揭示特异性的方向性规律
contributions.mechanism: 比较正/负/中性emoji的ESI并与valence指数做相关
contributions.evaluation: 负性emoji特异性高于正/中性;ESI与valence负相关r=-0.46(负性emoji更表达具体情绪)
contributions.source_quote: negative emojis show greater specificity than positive or neutral ones... ESI is systematically related to affective valence.

contributions.purpose: 刻画情绪评分的潜在结构
contributions.mechanism: 对13个标准化情绪变量做PCA
contributions.evaluation: PC1解释72.8%方差、构成valence连续体;PC2载荷anger/sadness,占7.4%
contributions.source_quote: the principal component analysis recovers a valence continuum explaining nearly 73 % of the variance

self_declared_provenance.quote: the concept of emodiversity the variety and relative abundance of emotions experienced by an individual has been formalised using Shannon's entropy (4)... Following emodiversity research (4), the emotion specificity index is ESI = 1 - H/log13
